title: Chapter 197
text:
The male host suddenly changed the topic. "Recently, a phenomenon has sparked widespread thought and discussion. The NPCs in the game have shown great curiosity due to the characteristics of the players. Every novice planet has a different reaction, such as the Chosen One phenomenon, the Inhuman phenomenon, the Genius phenomenon, and so on. This can't help but feel surprised and excited. It's as if the NPCs have independent thoughts and are not as inflexible as in other games."

"If every NPC has an independent logical thought, the calculation capacity will be terrifying, but Galaxy uses the latest generation of photon processors, and no one knows its limits," the female host said.

The comments flew up, and the spectating players made one guess after another. The NPCs had independent thoughts, and the freedom of interaction was almost the same as in the real world. It was too novel.

The two hosts read the script and summarized the different phenomena of each planet. They only made some guesses in the program.

From the players' point of view, they could only know the attitude of the NPCs they came into contact with, but they could not know the secret reaction of each organization. However, Han Xiao knew that the recent Dark Net intelligence was almost all about coming into contact with Inhumans. The increasing number of players was already pressuring the major organizations.

The major organizations all agreed that if the number of Inhumans kept increasing, there would be endless hidden dangers, and it would cause a huge impact on the overall situation. However, they could not find a way to suppress the growth of the Inhumans.

Luckily, the Inhumans were weak and easy to control.

At this time, the major organizations of Blue Star had not discovered the characteristics of the rapid growth of the players. Before LV 20, their combat power was still in the range of normal people.

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. When the players' levels are high, these organizations will be stunned.

The topic of the Inhuman phenomenon came to an end. The male host said, "… We have invited Li Ge to be our guest. Hello, Li Ge."

The second God of China, Li Ge, appeared in the camera. He sat in the middle of the hosts with a smile on his face.

Galaxy Times often invited top players for interviews to share information and opinions. The female host asked Li Ge what he thought of the Inhuman phenomenon.

"I feel that this is part of the game's plot, to increase the player's immersion and sense of reality. When I was playing, I often had the illusion that this was the real world. I think this is the experience that the developers want to give us, the feeling of being a special part of the real world. Every experience is random, and there are very few similar events. It is very novel and exciting. I am very optimistic about the future of Galaxy."

The male host said, "Speaking of the future of the game, our station has received first-hand information. The International E-Sports Association has confirmed that they will host the first Galaxy Pro League and allow countries to hold secondary competitions. What do you think about this?"

"It's probably the feeling that I haven't lost my job." Li Ge smiled. "Seriously, all the esports giants from all over the world have joined Galaxy. They will definitely be preparing for it. I think this will be a fierce battle. I hope I can lead China to a good result."

The bullet screen became densely packed. The formation of the Pro League made the players very excited. This was going to be a big event. At the same time, the bullet screen was mixed with comments from fangirls such as "Li Ge is so handsome!" and "My husband is so cute!"

"The competition has been established. The professional players need to prepare quickly. Do you have any experience that you can share with us?"

Li Ge thought about it and said, "Us pro players need to allocate EXP according to the characteristics of our abilities. We don't rush to level up. We need to play it safe and familiarize ourselves with the controls at every level to train our skill. That's why there are almost no professional players on the level leaderboard. Oh, there are a few in Japan. Everyone knows that they are very prideful. "

"We professional players need to grasp every opportunity to grow. Recently, our Blue Star's Black Phantom has become very famous. I think I will try my luck too … provided that he returns to the Southern Continent." Li Ge was helpless.

The rest of the program was mostly chit-chat.

After watching it, Han Xiaoxin said, "The Pro League has been established. All the big clubs will hurry to prepare. My customers will probably increase."

Li Ge said that he would look for him too. This was the second best player in China. Han Xiao did not even have the qualifications to meet Li Ge in his previous life.

But now, Han Xiao had the right to decide whether to let him be his backup.

"Li Ge … we'll see when the time comes."

…

Frenzied Sword and Bun-hit-dog were doing missions in Black Pine. Black Pine was not a place for players of their level, and the missions were very difficult. However, Frenzied Sword was a professional player after all, and his skill was there for all to see. He also had the equipment that Han Xiao had provided him, so he was doing very well and was growing very quickly.

Through the various missions at Black Pine, he had obtained new equipment and new skills. However, in Mad Blade's heart, these things could not fill his heart. Instead, they made him feel even more empty.

Thinking of Han Xiao, Mad Blade's heart was filled with longing.

Only by following him could he understand the true meaning of life. Compared to that, the missions at Black Pine were not attractive at all.

"When will he come back …"

Mad Blade was very melancholy.

Outside the quarantine area at Black Pine, Lu Cheng looked surprised. He said to Mad Blade, "To be honest, you surprised me. You successfully stopped the plague."

Mad Blade was unhappy. Pork Bun pulled him aside, and he came back to his senses. He answered absent-mindedly, "Oh."

At first, when Black Phantom left the two people behind to help solve the plague, Lu Cheng did not think much of it. However, he soon realized that the two people were really useful. Their ability to revive meant that they were not afraid of infection. They could do many things that researchers did not dare to do.

The plague in the settlement stopped spreading with the help of the two people. The mild cases were cured, and the number of people in the quarantine area decreased significantly.

Lu Cheng had always been very surprised by the Inhumans' characteristics. He also asked the garrison in Green Valley Town to study those 'refugees' … now they were called Inhumans. He contacted some of his friends from other forces and found out that Inhumans were everywhere in the world. As the Inhumans' range of activities expanded, even the Six Nations could not hide it from the civilians.

As their levels increased, the players in the novice village gradually explored the map. Many people left Green Valley Town, and some of them came to Black Pine.

Lu Cheng tried to use the method that Han Xiao taught him to treat the Inhumans as mercenaries. He was surprised to find that Han Xiao showed him a way.

"Erm … reward?" Bun-hit-dog reminded Lu Cheng, who was distracted.

Mad Blade looked at Pork Bun with disdain.

When doing missions, he did almost everything alone. Pork Bun was leisurely recording at the side like a big boss. He even had the face to ask for rewards.

Lu Cheng laughed and asked his subordinates to give the promised rewards to the two of them.

Counting the money and equipment in his hands, Mad Blade studied the attributes description seriously. The Pro League had been formed, and he felt the pressure. Whenever he had time, he would study battle techniques.

Pork Bun was very casual. He was browsing the forum. Suddenly, he said in surprise, "Black Phantom is doing something new again. He can even give out main storyline missions … Eh, why didn't he mention this to us? We triggered his hidden storyline. Why didn't we get this treatment?"

Mad Blade's face tightened. He said in a deep voice, "When he comes back, he will definitely give us the main storyline mission."

"Where did your confidence come from?" Pork Bun was suspicious.
